verdict.rationale: stagewise is a standalone agentic IDE with its own inline and side-by-side diff review, and it attaches context via @mentions inside that app. The GitHub README mentions generic "IDE integration to view and apply code changes in your favorite editor," and settings let you choose an external editor for opening files. But nothing in the evidence names JetBrains, shows interactive diffs rendered inside a JetBrains IDE, or shows sending a selected code range from JetBrains as agent context.
